items.title: Breadth rebuilt above threshold into the after-hours print while the short-horizon sector rotation target flipped from technology to communications, under an intact positive-gamma pin
items.note: Two owner reads moved in the same after-hours window in a way no single tool flags. Market breadth rebuilt from a sub-half pre-close cut to 65.06% of 134 constituents positive against the 60% threshold (margin +5.06, leadership broad), so participation now confirms rather than diverges from a bull-stacked bench (swing 20>50>200, 515 bars) and calm volatility (forecast 13.24%, throttle ×1.13). Yet in the same window the tool-aligned sector RRG flipped its rotate-into target from technology (the pre-close read) to communication services (XLC), and XLC is an early, still-weak turn — Improving quad I on accel +2.1 but bear-stacked with rsMom6m -16.04 and ma200Dist -0.98 — not an established leader. The tell is that broadening breadth is being led by a momentum-turn name that has not yet repaired its trend, while dealers stay positive-gamma (flip 770.66, walls 770/780, spot 777.96) and the intraday tape reads Mixed / developing rather than one-way. It is an emergent cross-tool divergence, not any single read: broad participation argues for staying engaged, but the rotation leadership is thin-quality and the pin cage keeps ranges tight, so the constructive breadth signal is lower-conviction than it looks and would firm only if XLC repairs its trend while breadth holds above 60%.
items.method: Cross-window, cross-tool divergence flag: compare the market-heatmap breadthPct-versus-threshold margin against its prior-window value to detect a breadth regime flip, then read the sector tool-aligned RRG rotate-into ticker and test whether that leader's own trend fields (maStack, rsMom6m, ma200Dist) confirm or contradict its quadrant, and overlay the dealer-gamma sign with spot-versus-flip position and the intraday session type. Raise the pattern when breadth crosses back above threshold AND the rotation leader is early-quadrant but trend-weak AND dealers remain positive-gamma with spot above the flip — a broad-but-thin-leadership tape rather than a clean broadening.
